# Loose Dentures - Los Angeles, CA



## End Denture Pain and Embarrassment



## Choose a More Secure Solution


Dentures have stood the test of time and are still in wide use for tooth replacement today. While they offer generally acceptable performance, they do have their downsides. If you’re already wearing dentures you may know these all too well. Dentures stay in place with suction or adhesive pastes. Through jawbone recession and wear they can come loose—often at the worst times. You may be eating or speaking with a friend and the dentures suddenly slip, embarrassing you. Their instability can also cause painful friction against your gums. If these concern you, our tooth replacement specialists at West LA Implants encourage you to consider options that put an end to loose dentures in Los Angeles, CA.


### Life without Loose Dentures


Carefree meals, conversations, laughter, and smiles

Improved self-confidence

True peace of mind

A greater selection of food choices

No denture-related gum irritation

No pastes required


## No-Slip Solutions


Our dentist at West LA Implants offers multiple paths to a secure smile in Los Angeles, CA, all with one element in common: dental implants. Implant supported dentures combine some features of dentures and dental implants in a single dental appliance. With this solution you have dental implants inserted into your jaw and then a full-arch denture attached to it. The implants stop your denture from shifting during meals and other daily activities, enable you to eat a wider, more satisfying variety of foods, and prevent the bone loss that can happen with traditional dentures due to lack of a root structure.

The next option is full mouth or full arch dental implants. This solution is widely considered to be the best overall choice for tooth replacement today. Created to last many years, with regular maintenance may provide up to a lifetime of dependable function and lifelike beauty. Anchored firmly in your jaw, dental implants are strong enough to allow you to eat all your favorite foods with confidence—hard, chewy, and crunchy foods. Dental implants don’t develop decay or infection and their restorations won’t stain. They can truly change your life!

## Let Us Craft Your Perfect Smile



### "Full Arch All-On-4 Gave Me My Confidence Back!" - Leslie


Patient's Story


## Completely Renovate Your Look


Do you find yourself covering your mouth when you smile? Do you avoid getting your picture taken? Are there certain foods you can’t eat, due to tooth pain and discomfort? We understand. That’s why along with veneers and crowns, we offer All-on-4® full arch implants in Los Angeles, CA! Also known as full mouth dental implants, All-on-4 full arch dental implants are permanent dental replacements for one or both arches of your teeth.

Get Pricing

Dr. Barriere Talks About Top 3 Transformative Cosmetic Dental Procedures


## Consider Your Options


At West LA Implants, we offer top-tier dental care, especially when it comes to implants. Even if other dentists have declined to perform dental implant surgery on you, Dr. Barriere at West LA Implants offers free second opinions, and he specializes in difficult cases. Find out if you’re a candidate for dental implant surgery today! We provide an assortment of choices – including traditional dentures, implant supported dentures, and All-on-4 permanent full mouth dental implants – for you, based on your needs.

If your current dental implants are failing or causing you pain, we can restore them with dental implant restorations. This procedure can enable you to live without mouth pain once again, but it requires a delicate touch and years of experience, which Dr. Barriere offers. A good compromise for people who want the stability and strength of dental implants, but aren’t able to commit to full mouth dental replacement, implant supported dentures — available in both full and partial — attach to posts that are implanted in your mouth. Compared to traditional dentures, they provide improved biting and chewing power and reduced friction. All-on-4 Dental Implants are ideal for people who are missing many teeth, as they replace all of your teeth at once. They permanently attach to your jaw, and you take care of them like you would your natural teeth.

Dr. Barriere Talks About Why Does Dental Implant Treatment Experience Matter?


## The West LA Implants Process



#### Step 1: Your Initial Visit


When you first visit our office, you’ll find a whole team of experts who are ready to help you find out whether dental implants are the right option for you. At your initial consultation, we’ll take a three-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) scan of your mouth and jaw. This helps us determine the ideal placement for implants, and we can also diagnose any issues that need to be treated before you receive them. From these scans, Dr. Barriere will create custom chrome surgical guides that enable the precision placement of your dental implants. These guides ensure that your posts are implanted onto the strongest part of your jaw, maximizing your chances of success.


#### Step 2: The Day of Surgery


Your next appointment will be your dental implant surgery. We offer oral, IV and nitrous oxide sedation for implant surgery, so your time in the chair will seem to pass in the blink of an eye. During your procedure, Dr. Barriere will remove any remaining teeth, then use guides to precisely implant four or more titanium or zirconia posts into specially chosen areas of your jawbone. During the next several months, these posts will fuse with your jaw in a process called osseointegration. Thanks to our TeethToday® technology, you’ll come away from surgery with temporary nanoceramic replacement teeth, then three to four months later, you’ll return for your final zirconia restorations.


#### Step 3: Final Steps


After three or more months, your posts will have sufficiently fused with your jawbone to support your restoration. When you return to our office, we’ll make sure your jaw is in good shape and we’ll place your final restoration, checking to make sure it fits well and feels good.

## It’s Time to Upgrade Your Smile


Do you find it difficult to smile openly with others? Are you embarrassed by the appearance of your teeth? You can upgrade your smile with personalized cosmetic dentistry in Los Angeles, CA! Through personalized treatments, including porcelain veneers, dental crowns, and teeth whitening, we can help you find confidence in your smile once again. Our cosmetic dentist is skilled in the artistry and functional aspects of cosmetic dentistry treatment. With a treatment plan tailored to your smile specifications, our West LA Implants team offers personalized and comfortable care, with predictable and long-lasting results!

Discolored teeth

Asymmetrical smile

Dr. Barriere Talks Why Does Dental Implant Treatment Experience Matter?


## Our Select Treatments



#### Porcelain Veneers


Veneers in Los Angeles, CA are thin shells of porcelain that cover just the front portion of the teeth that show when you smile. Once your teeth have been modified (a small portion of enamel removed), veneers will fit naturally and restore proper size, shape, and alignment. With minimal maintenance and maximum longevity, veneers are a beneficial and hassle-free choice for renewing your smile.


#### Dental Crowns


Crowns are porcelain or ceramic “caps” for your teeth that conceal cosmetic and functional damage. They are durable and crack-resistant, which makes them a good choice for molars and front teeth that are cracked, broken, or misshapen. A tooth crown can generally last 15 years or more when cared for properly.


#### Dental Bridges


Bridges are a fixed replacement for one or more missing teeth. Made up of two or more custom dental crowns fused together, dental bridges effectively restore function and aesthetics to your smile. They can also keep remaining teeth from shifting out of place and altering your bite. Dental bridges can also be attached to dental implants instead of adjacent natural teeth.


#### Teeth Whitening


Professional teeth whitening ranges from 1-hour whitening sessions in-office to take-home trays or strips with professional-grade bleaching gels. Depending on your time constraints and preferences, whitening can be customized to your needs as well as your specific smile goals. Our cosmetic dentist will monitor your treatment to ensure your whitening has natural and aesthetic results.


#### Inlays and Onlays


Sometimes teeth only need small cosmetic adjustments to restore their natural aesthetics and function. If you don’t need a complete crown, we offer inlays and onlays to spruce up your smile instead. Inlays replace an inside portion of a tooth and onlays restore one or more cusps of a tooth renewing strength and structure.


#### Orthodontics


Crooked teeth almost always result in cosmetic concerns, even if their misalignment isn’t causing functional problems affecting your bite. There’s a range of orthodontic treatment available today that can be tailored to your needs. We’ll help you determine which one will most effectively correct your crooked teeth and improve the aesthetics of your smile. Orthodontic treatment generally lasts between 6-24 months, depending on your unique case.

## Long-Lasting, Life-Changing Dental Implants


If you have one or more missing teeth, you may be struggling to bite and chew or feel embarrassed to talk, laugh, and socialize. Missing most or all your teeth can result in changes in your facial appearance, a decline in your health, and increased discomfort and/or self-consciousness. No matter how many teeth you are missing, dental implants are the “gold standard” solution. These permanent tooth replacements restore your oral health, smile esthetics and dental function and do so for decades! Our team at West LA Implants is experienced in providing dental implants in Los Angeles, CA, and can help you achieve a new smile and quality of life with this permanent solution.


## Make Dental Implants Your First Choice


Dental implants are made up of three components—a post, an abutment and a restoration—that mimic the function of natural teeth. Secured in your jawbone, dental implants are one of the most versatile tooth replacements available, able to replace any number of missing teeth. This permanent solution requires the precision of a skilled implant dentist and advanced surgical technology to optimize the outcomes of your treatment and its long-term success. Our team routinely provides dental implant treatment across a variety of cases, utilizing state-of-the-art technologies and high-quality materials for the best results. With our expertise, we can help you experience a life of health, function, and confidence with dental implants in Los Angeles, CA!

View More Results

Dental Implant & Crowns


## Your Custom Dental Implant Options


Dental implants can support a single dental crown or a dental bridge to replace one or more missing teeth in a row. Dental implants can also be used to increase the stability of a modified denture, which snaps securely to the implants placed in the jawbone. For patients with many or all missing teeth, dental implants can permanently support a full, fixed bridge of artificial teeth. This solution makes it possible to eat any type of food with life-like, strong teeth. In all cases, dental implants improve your ability to eat comfortably, feel confident in a complete smile, and live an overall healthier and better quality of life.

Single Implants

Dr. Barriere Talks About Why Does Dental Implant Treatment Experience Matter?


## Our Dental Implant Treatment Process


Your dental implant treatment at West LA Implants is personalized to your specific oral health needs and smile goals. You’ll first complete a consultation with our implant dentist in Los Angeles, CA, where we’ll discuss your dental and medical history, take digital X-rays, and create a custom treatment plan. Next, you’ll undergo surgery, which may involve tooth extractions and bone grafting along with dental implant placement. We use fully guided techniques for all our surgeries to ensure an efficient procedure, with exact and predictable results. You’ll be resting comfortably under sedation and remain pain-free during your surgery. In many cases, we’re able to attach a temporary tooth or set of teeth at this same appointment. As your mouth heals over the next three or more months, you’ll be able to eat comfortably and enjoy restored smile esthetics until you receive your permanent, custom-made dental implant restoration.

Get Pricing


## Why Choose Dental Implants?


Dental implants provide numerous advantages over other tooth replacement options. Unlike dental bridges, dental implants do not require healthy teeth to be present to support the restoration. Dental implants only need proper jawbone density to remain secure and strong, where they will in turn provide stimulation to keep the bone healthy. Unlike dentures, dental implants are permanently secured in your jawbone and act like artificial tooth roots (implant posts). They are permanently fixed and stable enough to restore over 99% of natural biting and chewing power. For this reason, implants are one of the preferred solutions and virtually all patients who come to West LA Implants are candidates for dental implants.

Dental function for proper biting and chewing

Aesthetic restorations for a natural look and feel

Complete smile makeover to dramatically boost confidence

Improvements to oral health and physical health

Significantly better overall quality of life

## Transform Your Entire Mouth


How long has it been since you smiled? Are you self-conscious when you eat? Do you have many failing or missing teeth? If so, this can have a lot of potential effects on your physical and mental health. Thankfully, you have options when it comes to replacing your teeth. We can put an end to your oral pain and help you live your best life! From dentures to All-on-4® dental implants in Los Angeles, CA, West LA Implants has a suite of full mouth dental replacements that can transform your smile and your life.

Get Pricing


## Your Tooth Replacement Options


At West LA Implants, Dr. Tony Barriere offers a variety of solutions to missing or failing teeth: dentures, implant supported dentures and All-on-4 dental implants. When you need to replace all of your teeth, it’s critical to know what your options are, and we want you to make an informed decision.

While they are the most affordable option initially, dentures aren’t a long-lasting solution to tooth loss. In many cases, they may end up causing problems such as jawbone recession or friction sores. Additionally, they require adhesive and special cleaners, and the expense and hassle of these can add up quickly.

Implant supported dentures are the next step up when replacing a full mouth of teeth. These fully removable dentures snap onto fixtures that are surgically implanted into your mouth. Due to these implants, they tend to stay on longer than traditional dentures, and they can also reduce jawbone loss. They even cost less than full mouth dental implants!

Finally, seen as the “gold standard” for full mouth dental replacement, All-on-4 dental implants are zirconium replacement teeth attached to four or more posts that are surgically implanted into your jaw. They restore nearly all of your biting and chewing power, and you take care of them the way you would take care of your original teeth.


#### Traditional Dentures


Lowest initial cost

Fragile

Must be removed at night

Restores approximately 25% of biting power

Requires adhesive agents such as glue


#### Implant Supported Dentures


Medium initial cost

Reduces jawbone recession

Fully removable

Fewer food restrictions

More biting and chewing power


#### Full Arch Fixed Teeth


Highest initial cost

Fully customized to your mouth

Permanently Fixed

99% restored biting and chewing power

A lifelong solution to tooth loss

When it comes to getting dental implants and dentures, you have a lot of options, especially in a city like Los Angeles. Our team believes that West LA Implants should be your first stop when looking for a full mouth replacement of any kind! Our approach provides the highest value for your payment, no matter which solution you choose.

We offer the newest, highest-end technology in our Los Angeles office, and Dr. Barriere is committed to continuing his education. That’s why he completed more than 300 hours of continuing education in 2021, on his mission to never stop learning.

West LA Implants also offers a one-year warranty on all dental implants: If a material fails within the first year after your implant, we’ll cover it 100% with no questions asked. We even offer free second opinions on all procedures!


## Making Your Perfect Smile Affordable


Whether you opt for full mouth dental implants or dentures, tooth replacement is one of the best things you can do for your smile and your ongoing health. However, we recognize that cost is often a barrier for our patients, especially when selecting All-on-4 dental implants. That’s why West LA Implants offers a variety of ways to make your perfect smile affordable, from providing in-house financing to partnering with a variety of dental insurance and third-party financing companies, we strive to make your ideal smile a real possibility for you.
